description: Action-level policy enforcement for AI agents — control what agents DO, not just what they say. Evaluate actions against configurable security policies before execution.

rawRecord.description: Action-level policy enforcement for AI agents — control what agents DO, not just what they say. Evaluate actions against configurable security policies before execution.

detail.description: Action-level policy enforcement for AI agents — control what agents DO, not just what they say. Evaluate actions against configurable security policies before execution.

tools.name: evaluate_action
tools.description: Evaluate whether an agent action is allowed by the guardrail policy. Call this BEFORE executing any tool, shell command, or HTTP request.

target.title: Target
target.description: Target resource path or URL, e.g. /etc/passwd, https://api.example.com.

agent_id.title: Agent Id
agent_id.description: Unique identifier of the agent. Must be registered first via register_agent.

cost_usd.title: Cost Usd
cost_usd.description: Estimated cost in USD for spend tracking and budget enforcement.

tool_name.title: Tool Name
tool_name.description: Name of the tool being invoked, e.g. bash, write_file, curl.

action_type.title: Action Type
action_type.description: Category of action: tool_call, shell, http, file_read, file_write, database, api_call.

tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Register a new agent with the guardrail system. Must be called before evaluate_action.

name.title: Name
name.description: Human-readable name for the agent, e.g. code-reviewer, data-analyst.

framework.title: Framework
framework.description: Agent framework: langchain, autogen, crewai, claude-code.

description.title: Description
description.description: Short description of what this agent does.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description:
List all agents currently registered in the guardrail system. Shows active and killed agents.

    Returns:
        Array of agent records with fields: id, name, framework, description, status, created_at.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description:
Retrieve aggregate statistics from the guardrail system including evaluation counts, policy data, and agent metrics.

    Returns:
        Statistics object with fields: total_evaluations, allowed_count, denied_count, agent_count, policy_count.

tools.name: kill_agent
tools.description: Emergency kill-switch: immediately block ALL actions for an agent. Use when an agent is misbehaving or compromised.

agent_id.title: Agent Id
agent_id.description: Unique identifier of the agent to kill. All subsequent actions will be denied.

tools.name: unkill_agent
tools.description: Re-enable a previously killed agent, restoring its ability to have actions evaluated.

agent_id.title: Agent Id
agent_id.description: Unique identifier of the agent to reactivate.

prompts.name: setup_guardrail
prompts.description: Step-by-step guide to set up guardrail enforcement for a new agent.

prompts.name: security_best_practices
prompts.description: Security best practices for AI agent governance.
